reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the redline is unchanged with no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding.

The rule's preferred position is that no non-solicit bind the Customer; the cited text (Art. XV general provisions, incl. 15.12 Independent Contractors) contains no solicitation, no-hire or inducement covenant, so absence of the covenant equals the preferred position rather than a 'missing' clause.
Failed deterministic checks (duration, carve-out) are expected artifacts of there being no non-solicit language to measure and do not indicate a defect.

Rationale accurately notes the only personnel-related obligation (RevMed making technical employees available for tech transfer) favors our side and is not a restrictive covenant, so no negotiation issue should be raised.
